correctness.rationale: Reflection diagonalizes the even weighted path into irreducible Jacobi blocks N_m and N_m+2w e_m e_m^T with disjoint simple spectra for w>0. PBH reduces sensor observability to eigenvector nonvanishing; cosine eigenvectors of N_m yield the exact gcd obstruction. Every odd-sector zero at j has theta=(2r-1)pi/(2j-1); solving the final boundary recurrence yields precisely the positive W_r with nonzero denominators. Replacing m by m+2j-1 reverses numerator and denominator signs, proving periodicity; j=2 explicitly yields the mod-3 trichotomy and one-dimensional nullspace. Standalone symbolic code checks 462 exact rational cases and 22 extra mod-3 cases, not the infinite generality.

originality.rationale: The closest read primary source (Parlangeli and Notarstefano 2011) classifies unweighted paths, whose one-parameter central-conductance perturbation is not varied. Zero-forcing theory guarantees endpoint controllability uniformly over weights but does not identify isolated loss of interior-sensor observability or arithmetic period classes. The constructed positive real exceptional-weight set, full quantifiers, and length-periodicity are a genuinely distinct one-defect family. Known one-edge-cycle findings concern a different topology and spectral boundary. No full novelty guarantee: a specialized Jacobi or 2019 one-edge line-graph perturbation source could implicitly imply the same formula.
residual_risks: No independent full literature audit. Specialized Jacobi inverse/one-defect spectral work could contain the same parameter classification or equivalent implication.
Full text of arXiv:1910.09617 was not inspected; its stated path single-edge eigendecomposition might imply parts of this result.

value.rationale: A one-defect path Laplacian is a natural sensor-placement/robustness model. The theorem classifies all positive defect weights and all interior single-sensor positions in an infinite family rather than numerically enumerating cases. A structural period q=2j-1 explains repeated length-resonances, and a complete three-way arithmetic robustness split at the second vertex isolates immune families versus one exact failure conductance. The exact threshold is meaningful for observability design but does not assert noisy estimation guarantees.
